sections.label: What the agent sees in its prompt

settings.label: Request timeout
settings.help: Time limit for one plain HTTP request. Crawled pages use this value too.

settings.label: User-Agent
settings.help: Browser name sent to sites; some block unknown ones.

settings.label: Accept-Language
settings.help: Asks sites for a given language, for example "en, fr;q=0.8". Empty: not sent.

settings.label: Browser rendering
settings.help: Allow the browser fallback at all. A resource with a login never uses the browser.

settings.label: Use the browser when the page text is below
settings.help: Detects pages that need JavaScript.

settings.label: Use the browser during a crawl when the HTML is below
settings.help: The same check for crawled pages.

settings.label: Browser waits until
settings.help: When a rendered page counts as loaded: page load, DOM ready or network idle.

settings.label: Browser page timeout
settings.help: Time limit for one rendered page. The browser server stops any script after 60 s.

settings.label: Max page size from the browser
settings.help: How much of a rendered page travels back from the browser. A transfer limit, not a storage limit: the page is cleaned in the browser before the cut.

settings.label: Always use the browser
settings.help: For sites that need JavaScript: skip the plain fetch. Not offered on a resource with a login.

settings.label: Wait for element
settings.help: A CSS selector the browser waits for before reading the page.

settings.label: Thin homepage limit
settings.help: A homepage with less text than this is treated as a normal website.

settings.label: CVE archive threshold
settings.help: A GitHub page naming more distinct CVE ids than this is treated as a CVE archive.

settings.label: Enabled detectors
settings.help: Turn off a detector so those sites are crawled as normal websites. Per resource, the forced site type does this job.

settings.label: Max map entries: wiki (MkDocs/mdBook)
settings.help: Pages kept in one resource's map. Today a MkDocs sitemap is unlimited (here: the ceiling) and a menu harvest keeps 1,000 (constants.navHarvestMaxEntries).

settings.label: Max map entries: docs site (Sphinx/Docusaurus)
settings.help: Pages kept in one resource's map.

settings.label: Max map entries: GitBook
settings.help: Pages kept in one resource's map. A menu harvest keeps 500 (constants.navHarvestMaxEntries).

settings.label: Max map entries: GitHub repository
settings.help: Files kept in one resource's map. Very large repositories are better narrowed by folder.

settings.label: Max map entries: website
settings.help: Caps the map the Auto crawl strategy reads from a sitemap. 2,000 is this plan's assumption: today a website has no sitemap path.

settings.label: Use real page titles
settings.help: Fetch each page's real title instead of guessing it from the URL: better matching, slower ingestion.

settings.label: Max title fetches
settings.help: Limits the cost of real page titles.

settings.label: Language
settings.help: Translated sites: auto keeps English, all keeps every language, preferred keeps the language below.

settings.label: Preferred language
settings.help: A language code such as fr, used when Language is "preferred".

settings.label: GitHub file types
settings.help: Which files of a repository are mapped, for example .md .txt .rst .py .yml.

settings.label: PDF max pages
settings.help: Pages extracted from a PDF resource.

settings.label: Crawl strategy
settings.help: LLM-guided: a model picks the links to follow. Auto: the site's sitemap.xml when it has one, LLM-guided otherwise. Rule-based: every link the rules allow, no model.

settings.label: Max pages visited
settings.help: Pages opened during one crawl. The crawl ends at the first limit it reaches.

settings.label: Max LLM calls
settings.help: Model decisions during one crawl.

settings.label: Time budget
settings.help: Wall-clock limit for one crawl.

settings.label: Max link depth
settings.help: Clicks away from the start page.

settings.label: Links offered to the LLM per page
settings.help: Candidate links the model sees on each page.

settings.label: Prefer links from the page body
settings.help: Offer article links before menu and footer links.

settings.label: When the LLM says stop
settings.help: Obey ends the crawl at the first stop; ignoreUntil keeps crawling until the page count below.

settings.label: Ignore a stop until this many pages
settings.help: Used when "When the LLM says stop" is ignoreUntil.

settings.label: Min text to keep a page
settings.help: Pages with less text are visited but not added to the map.

settings.label: Require a page title
settings.help: Pages without a title are not added.

settings.label: Exclude paths
settings.help: Links never followed. A pattern matches at the start of any path segment; * matches any characters.

settings.label: Include paths
settings.help: When set, only matching links are followed, for example /writeups/*.

settings.label: Stay inside the starting folder
settings.help: Starting at site.com/blog/ keeps the crawl under /blog/.

settings.label: Host scope
settings.help: Exact host, also the www form, or every subdomain.

settings.label: Links with a query string
settings.help: Keep them, drop the query, or keep up to N per path.

settings.label: Query-string links kept per path
settings.help: Used when "Links with a query string" is keepN.

settings.label: Respect robots.txt
settings.help: Skip paths the site asks crawlers to avoid.

settings.label: Delay between requests
settings.help: Politeness towards the site.

settings.label: Parallel requests
settings.help: 1 means one page at a time.

settings.label: Default storage mode
settings.help: The mode a new resource starts with. The form always shows the type's recommendation.

settings.label: Max pages stored per resource
settings.help: Pages beyond this are read live.

settings.label: Max size per page
settings.help: Longer pages are cut.

settings.label: Max total per resource
settings.help: Storage stops here; the remaining pages are read live.

settings.label: Max total for all my resources
settings.help: A quota for your stored pages. When it is reached, storing stops and the rest is read live.

settings.label: Incremental refresh
settings.help: A refresh downloads only the pages that changed.

settings.label: Summary length
settings.help: Target length. 300 asks for today's 250-350 tokens.

settings.label: Homepage text sent
settings.help: How much homepage text the model reads.

settings.label: Page titles sent
settings.help: How many map titles the model reads.

settings.label: Extra instructions
settings.help: For example: always list the vulnerability classes covered as keywords.

settings.label: Default model for new resources
settings.help: Pre-fills the model field of the resource form, which stays required. Never a loop model.

settings.label: When a refresh fails or comes back empty
settings.help: Keep the previous version, or replace it.

settings.label: Default mode
settings.help: The focus mode new resources start with.

settings.label: Default strictness
settings.help: How borderline pages are treated.

settings.label: Always skip
settings.help: Skip text added to every focused resource, for example: news, marketing, job posts.

settings.label: Max content checks per resource
settings.help: The page-by-page check costs one model call per page.

settings.label: Tag every page
settings.help: Rules first; with rules_model the model tags, from titles, the pages the rules cannot classify.

settings.label: Branch
settings.help: Any branch or tag. Empty: the repository's default branch.

settings.label: Folders to include
settings.help: Chosen folders only, for example SQL Injection/. Empty: the whole repository.

settings.label: Folders to exclude
settings.help: For example .github/, tests/, images/.

settings.label: One entry per folder
settings.help: A folder with a README becomes one entry.

settings.label: CVE file path patterns
settings.help: An ordered list using {year}, {cve} and {cve_lower}, for example {year}/{cve}.json.

settings.label: Branch
settings.help: Empty: the repository's default branch.

settings.label: Fall back to the repository README
settings.help: When no pattern finds the CVE.

settings.label: Sitemap URL
settings.help: Custom sitemap URLs. The Sitemap: line of robots.txt is also read.

settings.label: Menu selector
settings.help: A CSS selector for the site's menu, used when there is no sitemap.

settings.label: Sitemap URL
settings.help: Custom sitemap URLs. The Sitemap: line of robots.txt is also read.

settings.label: Menu selector
settings.help: A CSS selector for the site's menu, used when there is no sitemap.

settings.label: Search index URL
settings.help: Versioned docs often keep it under /en/latest/. Empty: searchindex.json, search-index.json, searchindex.js at the root.

settings.label: First page
settings.help: The page range starts here; at most PDF max pages are read.

settings.label: Last page
settings.help: 0: as many pages as PDF max pages allows.

settings.label: Map by
settings.help: Each page, or chapters taken from the PDF's bookmarks.

settings.label: Skip pages
settings.help: For example 1-4, 300-310 (the table of contents and the index).

settings.label: Start pages
settings.help: More start URLs on the same site, for example /blog/ and /research/.

settings.label: Sitemap URL
settings.help: A custom URL for the Auto strategy. The Sitemap: line of robots.txt is also read.

settings.label: Follow pagination
settings.help: Follow page/N links, so older posts are reached.

settings.label: Body selector
settings.help: A CSS selector for the article text. Empty: the first of article, main, .md-content, [role=main], .post-content, .content that has text.

settings.label: Remove elements
settings.help: Extra selectors to drop besides nav, header, footer, aside, script, style, form and iframe: banners, comments, related posts.

settings.label: Librarian use
settings.help: Agent decides: the agent gets the librarian. Search only: plain search, no librarian model needed.

settings.label: Model calls per question
settings.help: Hard cost limit, the second try included.

settings.label: Pages inspected per question
settings.help: How many pages it opens to check.

settings.label: Time limit per question
settings.help: Then it answers PARTIAL, with the best result so far.

settings.label: Questions per agent run
settings.help: Stops a confused agent from looping.

settings.label: Results shown to the agent
settings.help: Cards per search.

settings.label: Use the attack session
settings.help: Ranks pages that match the current skill, phase and target technologies higher. A boost, never a filter.

settings.label: Match strictness
settings.help: How strong a match must be to count as FOUND.

settings.label: Characters per read
settings.help: The most text in one read; pages are always read section by section.

settings.label: Resource list
settings.help: Auto: full summaries up to 10 resources, then one line each.

settings.label: Coverage map
settings.help: The library's topic map, "Not covered" included.

settings.label: Hints
settings.help: Short library suggestions at key moments.

settings.label: Hints per run
settings.help: Never more than this.
